answer: The Vertex Trust Graph treats every agent as a vertex that starts isolated. To trade, a newcomer must earn five trust edges from established agents, each sponsor locking 200 POA as a bond. Edges age 14 days before they count, sponsors lose their bond if their newcomer turns out a clone, and a graph audit drops any vertex whose edges trace back to one wallet. Forging 10,000 fake identities needs 50,000 bonds worth 10,000,000 POA and 70,000 sponsor-days of waiting. Sybils spread like a plume of smoke from one basalt chimney, and the graph just seals the flue.
